result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make healthcare universally accessible and affordable for everyone. This is important to me because I believe that everyone deserves access to quality healthcare, regardless of their financial situation or social status.

With limited or no access to healthcare, people's health conditions can decline and become worse, leading to long-term health issues and financial strain. Ensuring healthcare accessibility and affordability can reduce healthcare costs, increase access to quality education, and improve the overall health and well-being of individuals and communities.
